classification.difficultyReason: Identify matching end faces in each net, mentally fold the rectangular faces and translate the net into a drawing of the corresponding prism.

content.prompt: In each case below, the surface of a solid has been cut open and opened up as shown. Draw the original solid.

spec.description: Four congruent rectangles in a vertical strip, with square end faces attached to either side of the second rectangle from the top.
spec.mathematics: Square-ended rectangular-prism net; central rectangle width is twice its height. No measurements are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: The net is supplied; the folded solid is withheld.

answer.short: A rectangular prism with square ends.
answer.worked: The two squares form opposite end faces. Fold the four rectangles around them to form a rectangular prism with square ends.

spec.description: Completed rectangular prism with square end faces and dashed hidden edges.
spec.mathematics: Four rectangular side faces join two congruent square ends.

spec.description: Four congruent rectangles in a vertical strip; squares attach to either side of the third rectangle from the top.
spec.mathematics: Square-ended rectangular-prism net; central rectangle width is four times its height. No measurements are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: The net is supplied; the folded solid is withheld.

answer.short: A long rectangular prism with square ends.
answer.worked: The two squares form opposite end faces. Fold the four long rectangles around them to form a long rectangular prism with square ends.

spec.description: Completed elongated rectangular prism, with square ends and dashed hidden edges.
spec.mathematics: Four long rectangular side faces join two square ends.

spec.description: Three upright rectangles with isosceles triangular ends attached above and below the wider middle rectangle. Red dashed lines mark folds.
spec.mathematics: A triangular-prism net with congruent isosceles triangular ends. No dimensions or right-angle marks are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: The net is supplied; the folded solid is withheld.

answer.short: A triangular prism with isosceles triangular ends.
answer.worked: The congruent triangles form opposite end faces. Fold the three rectangles around the triangles to form a triangular prism.

spec.description: Triangular prism with a visible isosceles triangular end, three joining edges, and dashed hidden rear edges.
spec.mathematics: Two congruent isosceles triangular ends joined by three rectangular faces.

spec.description: Three upright rectangles, with triangular ends above and below the middle rectangle; each triangle's vertical side continues the middle rectangle's right edge. Red dashed folds; no printed angle marks.
spec.mathematics: Source schematic represents a triangular prism with right-triangular ends. Source rectangle widths are retained schematically rather than treated as measured lengths.
spec.answerVisibility: The net is supplied; the folded solid is withheld.

answer.short: A triangular prism with right-triangular ends.
answer.worked: The congruent right triangles form opposite end faces. Fold the three rectangles around them to form a triangular prism with right-triangular ends.

spec.description: Completed triangular prism with right-angle marks on the triangular ends and dashed hidden edges.
spec.mathematics: Two congruent right-triangular ends joined by three rectangular faces; right-angle marks follow the perpendicular base and vertical edges.
